sections.title: Three new infinitives
sections.content: You know *enni* and *inni* after *szeretnék*. Here are three more verbs you need in a restaurant: *fizet → fizetni* (to pay), *vár → várni* (to wait) and *foglal → foglalni* (to book). Each is the verb stem plus *-ni*. A thing you book keeps its *-t*: *asztalt foglalni*.

sections.title: Saying what you are
sections.content: At the table you may also need to say who you are: *Vegetáriánus vagyok.* (I am a vegetarian.) With *nem* and the dish: *Nem kérek húst.* (I do not want meat.) You know *éhes* and *szomjas*: *Éhes vagyok.* *Szomjas vagyok.*

items.english: Anna would like to book a table.

sections.content: The infinitive never changes. The person sits on *szeretnék / szeretnél / szeretne*: *Szeretnék fizetni*, *Anna szeretne várni*.
